caption_L1: Here a bar diagram is titled Total number of lululemon athletica stores worldwide from 2011 to 2020 , by country. The y-axis measures Country while the x-axis measures 2015.
caption_L2L3: The United States had the most Lululemon stores of all the countries on this bar-chart. The United States has around 270 Lululemon stores. Canada is the second highest with around 50 stores. Australia is third highest with around 25 stores. All of the countries on the bar-chart except the United States have less than 50 stores. Germany and Puerto Rico do not have any stores. Hong Kong and Singapore only have 1 store each. There is no trend in the data.
